set -eu
sudo tee /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker >/dev/null <<'INVENTORY_WORKER_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
while :; do
    printf '%s inventory worker alive pid=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$$" >> /var/lib/inventory/worker.log
    sleep 5
done
INVENTORY_WORKER_EOF
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service >/dev/null <<'INVENTORY_UNIT_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Long-running inventory background worker
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/libexec/inventory-worker
Restart=always
RestartSec=2s
DynamicUser=yes
StateDirectory=inventory
WorkingDirectory=/var/lib/inventory
UMask=0077

# Filesystem and privilege confinement
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
PrivateDevices=yes
PrivateIPC=yes
PrivateUsers=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
SystemCallArchitectures=native
RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

set -eu
pid=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value inventory-worker.service)
printf 'main_pid=%s\n' "$pid"
printf '%s\n' '--- kernel privilege state ---'
sudo awk '/^(Uid|Gid|NoNewPrivs):/ {print}' "/proc/$pid/status"
printf '%s\n' '--- actual service mount namespace write test ---'
sudo nsenter -t "$pid" -m -- /bin/sh -c '
  if touch /etc/inventory-worker-forbidden 2>/dev/null; then
    rm -f /etc/inventory-worker-forbidden
    echo "outside_write=/etc unexpectedly_allowed"
    exit 1
  else
    echo "outside_write=/etc denied"
  fi
  if touch /tmp/inventory-worker-forbidden 2>/dev/null; then
    rm -f /tmp/inventory-worker-forbidden
    echo "outside_write=/tmp unexpectedly_allowed"
    exit 1
  else
    echo "outside_write=/tmp denied"
  fi
  touch /var/lib/inventory/confinement-probe
  echo "inside_write=/var/lib/inventory allowed"
  rm -f /var/lib/inventory/confinement-probe
'
printf '%s\n' '--- installed unit ---'
systemctl cat inventory-worker.service
